stats.notes: Fall 2025 entering class (Common Data Set 2025-2026; the PDF's page headers still say 2024-2025, but its questions and counts are for Fall 2025). Applicants, admits and enrollees by gender and by residency (in-state, out-of-state, international) add up to the same totals. The waitlist figures are as printed (10,741 offered a place, 2,963 accepted, 15 admitted). The ED figure covers Early Decision applications for the Fall 2025 entering class; Fairfield also offers nonbinding Early Action. Undergraduate enrollment (5,671) is the CDS B1 total and the nonresident count (109) is the B2 degree-seeking undergraduate figure. SAT/ACT submit rates are the printed percentages (258 and 54 enrolled first-years); scores are optional, so the percentile ranges describe the 17% who submitted SAT and the 4% who submitted ACT (no ACT section scores reported). The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column of C11. For comparison, Fairfield's first-year admission page prints 21,662 applications and a 21% admit rate for the Class of 2030, the class entering a year after this CDS (SAT 1320-1420, ACT 29-33 for admitted students).
